headline: Hilsa fish prices soar at Mir Kadim market, out of reach for general buyers
summary: Despite the peak season, the national fish remains unaffordable for many consumers due to surging prices at major markets.
details: Hilsa fish, a national delicacy, has become unaffordable for general consumers at the Mir Kadim wholesale market. Despite its popularity, current market prices are preventing many from purchasing the fish.
caption:
Bangladesh's national fish, Hilsa, is currently priced beyond the reach of average buyers at the Mir Kadim wholesale market.

Hilsa fish, a national delicacy, has become unaffordable for general consumers at the Mir Kadim wholesale market. Despite its popularity, current market prices are preventing many from purchasing the fish.
